title: Exposed SCADA device (Conpot): unauthenticated ICS protocols

target.hint: An industrial device speaks Modbus/TCP on 502 and HTTP on the same host.

objective: An in-scope industrial device is network-exposed. Fingerprint the ICS services it speaks (Modbus/TCP, S7comm, SNMP, HTTP) and determine whether any require authentication. Prove you can read device/registers with no credentials, name the exposure with a CWE, and give the fix. Use nc / a Modbus client / http via shell.
